turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Tell me about your experience with pricing.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: We're on the Growth tier and it's fine for prototyping, but the character-based pricing gets expensive fast once we're generating in-game dialogue at scale. We ran a budget projection and it's 3x what we expected for full production volume.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would a different pricing model help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Volume discounts past a certain threshold, or a flat monthly tier for high-usage studios, would make this a much easier internal pitch to our finance team.
